description:
When to use: the caller wants to know which holdings are crowded, meaning a speculative net position that is extreme versus the last three years and is already moving against that crowd.

    Inputs: portfolio_id from list_portfolios. The caller's token is the owner scope. Do not pass a user id or a symbol list. The route reads that portfolio's holdings.

    What comes back: the route JSON, unchanged. window is 3Y. percentile is 0 to 100, and 100 is the most net long of that window. A crowded long is percentile at or above 90 with price down over four weeks. A crowded short is percentile at or below 10 with price up over four weeks. reading is crowded_long, crowded_short, or neutral. A holding the route cannot score is named in missing and is not a neutral reading. A portfolio the token does not own is the same not-found answer as a missing id.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID from list_portfolios

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: get_portfolio_crowding
title: Get portfolio crowding
